name: anlide/hilos-demo-pmd
description: PMD - PhpMyAdmin with WebSocket demo project for Hilos v2 framework

scripts.hilos-frontend-reminder: @php -r "echo PHP_EOL . 'Hilos frontend: run npm install in the frontend container after composer changes, so the vendored SDK is not stale - see framework/frontend/README.md.' . PHP_EOL;"
scripts.setup-env: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile composer run --rm pmd-cli-local sh -c "cd /app && cp -n .env.example .env || true; ls -l .env"
scripts.install-deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local composer install
scripts.daemon-status: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:status
scripts.daemon-monitor: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:monitor
scripts.cli: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php
scripts.db:migration:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:up
scripts.db:migration:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:down
scripts.db:migration:status: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:status
scripts.db:migration:retry: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:retry
scripts.db:seed:apply: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:seed:apply
scripts.db:schema:status: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm pmd-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:schema:status
scripts.frontend:install: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm pmd-frontend-cli-local npm install
scripts.frontend:check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm pmd-frontend-cli-local npm run check
scripts.frontend:lint: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm pmd-frontend-cli-local npm run lint
scripts.frontend:format-check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm pmd-frontend-cli-local npm run format:check
scripts.frontend:build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm pmd-frontend-cli-local npm run build
scripts.test:install-deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm --no-deps pmd-cli-test composer install --no-interaction
scripts.test:cli-image: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli build pmd-cli-test
test:db-reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm pmd-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:db:reset
scripts.test:db-wait: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm pmd-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:wait
scripts.test:e2e-seed-users: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm pmd-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:user:seed 25
scripts.test:db-prepare: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm pmd-cli-test sh -c "php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:wait && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:db:reset && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:orphan:create e2e_orphan_delete string seed-value && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:user:seed 25 && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:user:seed 1 --prefix=timezone-chosen --time-zone=Pacific/Honolulu && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:user:seed 50 --prefix=timezone-pagination"
scripts.test:unit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm pmd-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite unit
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm pmd-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite integration
scripts.test:phpunit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm pmd-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml
test:check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm pmd-frontend-cli-test sh -c "node ../../../framework/frontend/scripts/npm-install-if-stale.mjs && npm run check && npm run lint && npm run format:check"
docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm pmd-e2e-runner sh -c "npm run lint && npm run format:check"
scripts.test:e2e-build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm pmd-frontend-cli-test sh -c "node ../../../framework/frontend/scripts/npm-install-if-stale.mjs && npm run build && npm run test:table-geometry:build && npm run test:modal-geometry:build"
scripts.test:e2e-install: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm pmd-e2e-runner node ../../../../framework/frontend/scripts/npm-install-if-stale.mjs
scripts.test:e2e-check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm pmd-e2e-runner npm run check
scripts.test:e2e-time-zone: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --quiet-build --rm --no-deps -T --entrypoint php pmd-daemon-test /hilos/framework/frontend/scripts/e2e-time-zone-env.php 'Demo\Pmd\Hilos' | docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --quiet-build --rm --no-deps -T --entrypoint node pmd-e2e-runner /hilos/framework/frontend/scripts/e2e-time-zone.mjs
test:e2e-up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e up -d --build pmd-daemon-test pmd-nginx-test
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm pmd-e2e-runner node ../../../../framework/frontend/scripts/playwright-run.mjs
scripts.test:all: composer run test:db-reset && composer run test:phpunit && composer run test:down && composer run test:e2e-full
